root_cause: PR #3986 was scoped to shallow-safe material writeback but also modified tools/delivery/delivery-metadata-authority.mjs. That unrelated collateral change made a complete mutable PR body override the versioned exact-head manifest for the same obligation, contradicting the One Loop authority contract introduced in #1968.
prevention: For the same Obligation-ID, a valid POWERHOUSE-DELIVERY-CANDIDATE-v1 manifest is authoritative over mutable PR delivery metadata. PR-body authority is retained only when no manifest exists or when the manifest belongs to a different obligation. Existing regression tests remain the executable guard.

evidence.failing_test: versioned exact-head manifest overrides stale mutable PR delivery metadata for the same obligation
